'''Gauron Nas Tal''' was a [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]] combat expert hired by<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> no later than [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> The Saurin trained the Hutt's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guard [[Ortugg]],<ref name="Insider60">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> and<ref name="CCG" /> the nine others he led.<ref name="Insider60" /> Nas Tal regretted accepting the job, harboring a dislike of Jabba and of his hired henchmen. The combat expert disliked the Hutt enough to plot his [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="CCG" /> similar to other subordinates of Jabba.<ref name="Bib's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>  

During the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] unknowingly accomplished Gauron Nas Tal's intended goal by murdering the Hutt on the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']]. 

==Behind the scenes==
Gauron Nas Tal first appeared, unidentified, in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The throne room and sail barge scenes featuring the character were shot at [[Elstree Studios]] in [[1982]]; the former filmed between [[January 25]] and [[February 8|Feburary 8]], and the latter filmed between [[February 9]] and [[February 11]].<ref name="Making of2">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In [[1998]], the character was identified by the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] published by [[Decipher]].<ref name="CCG" /> The card that identified the character provided the name "Garon Nas Tal," while "[[Who's Who in Jabba's Palace]]," an article written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 60|sixtieth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Insider60" /> on [[June 4]], [[2002]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20020510.html|text=Post-''Clones'' Fan Magazines}}</ref> provided the name "Gauron Nas Tal."<ref name="Insider60" /> This article assumes the more recent source provides the correct identification.
